slug: 2025-08-28 Madagascar seeks firm to expand digital interoperability platform

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit (UGD), under the World Bank-financed PRODIGY project, issued a call for expressions of interest in August 2025 for a firm to help operationalise and scale up the national interoperability platform, with bidders required to have deployed X-Road or equivalent platforms.
